---
title: "Attribute and class passthrough"
format: html
filters:
  - value-box
---

Regression guard: a box with none of these extras must render exactly as it
did before this feature existed.

::: {.value-box value="1"}
No extras
:::

The id, an extra class, and a mix of attributes: role/aria-label are the
kind Pandoc itself keeps unprefixed on an ordinary div, data-id is already
namespaced, top is neither and gets a data- prefix so the output stays
valid HTML. Note the extra class is a made-up name, not `.absolute` —
that particular class only positions an element via a *different* Quarto
filter that runs before divs become raw HTML, so it never sees this one;
the class name survives here but would do nothing.

::: {#kpi-1 .value-box .custom-hook role="group" aria-label="Sales this quarter" data-id="box1" top="200px" value="2"}
Kitchen sink
:::

A literal style attribute would collide with the box's own style attribute
if emitted, so it is dropped rather than producing two style attributes on
one tag.

::: {.value-box style="color:red" value="3"}
Literal style is dropped
:::

Passthrough has to work on the href branch (an anchor) too, not just the
plain div.

::: {.value-box href="https://example.com" data-tracking="promo" value="4"}
Link with a passthrough attribute
:::

A quote in a passthrough value must not be able to break out of the
attribute and inject a new one.

::: {.value-box data-note='payload" onmouseover="alert(1)' value="5"}
Escaped attribute value
:::

A literal data-fragment-index attribute would collide with the one
generated from the index attribute below, so it is dropped the same way a
literal style attribute is.

::: {.value-box fragment="true" index="1" data-fragment-index="9" value="6"}
Literal data-fragment-index is dropped
:::

Attribute names are matched case-insensitively, since HTML attribute names
are themselves case-insensitive and Quarto's own postprocessing lowercases
them regardless — so a mixed-case Role should pass through unprefixed, not
end up double-prefixed as data-role.

::: {.value-box Role="group" value="7"}
Mixed-case attribute name
:::
